sentences.text: Applicant-accused is present in-person.
He is identified by Ms. Medha Pande, Advocate.
The respondent no.3 is present in-person.
She is identified by Mr. Apoorv Chauhan, Advocate.
5. Both, applicant and the respondent no.3 submitted that they have resolved their all the differences and after resolving their differences they are living happily.
They have filed a Compounding Application (IA No.01 of 2025) and affidavits with their free will and without any pressure.
6. The respondent no.3, aged about 48 years, has requested to quash the entire proceedings of the said Sessions Trial No.56 of 2025.
7. Mr. Pradeep Lohani, learned Brief Holder, has opposed the said request on the ground that the offence under Section 376 read with Section 511 is non-compoundable.
8. Having heard.
It is noticed that the applicant and the victim have resolved their differences and now they are living happily.
In these circumstances, in case, the proceedings are allowed to continue, it would 2025:UHC:11599 amount to denial of complete justice to the parties.
Therefore, it is a case, in which the inherent jurisdiction of this Court should be exercised to do real and substantial justice.

9. Considering the totality of the matter, this Court is of the view that ends of justice would be met if the entire proceedings of Sessions Trial No.56 of 2025, "State vs. Rajesh", pending before the court of learned Additional Sessions Judge/Fast Track Special Court, Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar under, are quashed.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
10. Resultantly, the present Application, filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, is allowed and the entire proceedings of Sessions Trial No.56 of 2025, "State vs.
Rajesh", pending before the court of learned Additional Sessions Judge/Fast Track Special Court,
Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar under, are hereby quashed.
